# nlohmann/json

Pinned single-header release: [v3.12.0](https://github.com/nlohmann/json/releases/tag/v3.12.0).

`json.hpp` is the upstream `single_include/nlohmann/json.hpp` file, unmodified. SHA-256: `aaf127c04cb31c406e5b04a63f1ae89369fccde6d8fa7cdda1ed4f32dfc5de63`. The upstream MIT license is copied as `LICENSE.MIT`.

Community and updater wire responses are strict JSON. Texture manifests use a separate JSONC reader and are outside this dependency boundary.
